up: List all approved drugs indicated for cancer. For each drug, provide the following details: the ChEMBL ID, the drug name, the chemical structure (canonical SMILES), and the indication details (mesh_id and mesh_heading). sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_id, di.mesh_heading FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (di.mesh_heading LIKE '%Neoplasm%' OR di.mesh_heading LIKE '%Carcinoma%' OR di.mesh_heading LIKE '%Lymphoma%' OR di.mesh_heading LIKE '%Leukemia%' OR di.mesh_heading LIKE '%Melanoma%' OR di.mesh_heading LIKE '%Sarcoma%' OR di.mesh_id LIKE 'D%')
